dependence_theorems.common_mode: Multiplying all site phasors by any common unit factor leaves every intensity realization unchanged, regardless of that factor's dependence on the residual phases.
dependence_theorems.gaussian_sufficient_parameters: (P mu, P C P), P=I-11^T/n; this pair determines the full intensity law for fixed geometry.
dependence_theorems.equicorrelation: For P mu=0 (including centered phases), C=s*((1-rho)*I+rho*11^T), -1/62<=rho<=1, has the iid-Gaussian intensity law at variance s_eff=s*(1-rho).
dependence_theorems.rigid_endpoint: rho=1 and P mu=0 give I=0 at the exact common null.
dependence_theorems.phase_parameter_limit: s and rho are not separately identifiable from intensity under this centered-phase extended model; only s*(1-rho) is.

two_site_examples.unequal_mean_general_gap: 2*d^2, when both selected site phase means change from common m to m+d in both structures
two_site_examples.geometry_general_mean_gap: 8*exp(-s)*sin(epsilon/2)^2, rotating both selected site geometry phases by the same epsilon

L8_robustness.geometry_only_uniform_position_error: 1/(4200000*pi), in the coordinate units with q0=pi/3
L8_robustness.combined_geometry_covariance_budget: sum_j |epsilon_j+(P mu)_j| + 20*||P C P-log(2)*P||_F <= 1/200000, separately for each geometry
L8_robustness.scope: All are sufficient conservative tolerances. Fourth-moment distinctness survives; lower-moment equalities need not. Alternative rows are not additive budgets unless the stated combined inequality holds.

TV_robustness.scope: Reference is the full iid Gaussian phase-vector law at s=log(2); geometry is exact. Joint-TV result allows arbitrary within-snapshot dependence.

verification_scope: Exact reference moments rebuilt with the foundation cumulant engine and compared to its saved witness.
Heterogeneous and geometry mean examples checked by direct exact sums of site phases.
Robustness radii, budgets, and margins certified with rational arithmetic.
General distributional and norm arguments are analytic proofs in the companion note.
No simulation, external experiment, external human peer review, or formal proof-assistant verification.
Between-snapshot residual dependence is not analyzed; these extensions concern the single-snapshot intensity law.
